description: This file contains test cases for the React component 'App'. It uses '@testing-library/react' to test rendering, user interaction, and data fetching functionalities related to a weather forecast application. Mock fetch responses simulate server endpoints for weather search and forecast data.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up fetch mock before each test to intercept API calls and return predefined weather data responses.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets mock functions after each test to clean up test environment.

methods.name: test('renders header brand and search UI')
methods.description: Verifies that the application renders the header and search UI elements.

methods.name: test('performs a successful search and renders forecast')
methods.description: Simulates a user searching for a weather location and checks that forecast details are rendered properly after data fetch.
